OBSERVED:
- Nicolas currently sees two SUPRA windows/instances.
- Canonical target is ~/Applications/SUPRA.app.
- Known legacy competing bundles: ~/Applications/SUPRA-FRANCE.app and ~/Applications/SUPRA-FRANCE-CLEAN.app.
- The existing updater previously used "open -n", which can explicitly create a new app instance.
- Canonical source patches now enforce a single SwiftUI Window and remove updater "open -n" behavior.

DO NOW:
1) Run the exact existing recovery script RECOVERY/FIX_SUPRA_DUPLICATE_INSTANCES_V1_20260922.sh from the canonical branch, or perform its equivalent commands if local source has not caught up.
2) Retire only the known user-space legacy app bundles, reversibly. Do not delete patrimony.
3) Quit/kill all live SUPRA processes, then launch ~/Applications/SUPRA.app exactly once WITHOUT -n.
4) Prove pgrep -x SUPRA returns exactly one PID and prove its command path is ~/Applications/SUPRA.app/Contents/MacOS/SUPRA.
5) Wait for canonical CI success for the single-window/updater patches, then run the existing SUPRA autoupdater once so the prevention fix is installed. Preserve rollback.
6) Recheck exactly one live SUPRA PID after the update.
7) Continue existing Grande Mission from current state; do not restart completed phases.
8) Return proof only; do not ask Nicolas to click anything.
